title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Solo #20 (대각 띠·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her mid 20s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and dominating her entire middle, an enormous taut, high, rounded pregnant belly, far larger and more prominent than any ordinary pregnancy, projecting forward dramatically, the navel pushed outward on its smooth rounded surface. Enormous round hips below it, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, a fierce, playful expression, vivid copper-orange hair styled in a short pixie cut, real pores, real living eyes, 25 segment rings piercings set with diamonds in gold-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of silver earrings. Full body painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 30% of the way down her figure from the top and about 67% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), wide mother-of-pearl bands following the contours of the body, with dense scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), wide ochre bands following the contours of the body, with spiral floral bands filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
